text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, November 10, 2019, Appeal DDRT2020-05

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, that the conditions of the order remain in effect, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Chunsheng Fang and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 7, 2020.
